title: More From Mesopotamia
summary:
Iraqi crude oil production
After OPEC decided in November 2014 to maintain market share rather than protect the oil price, total OPEC output has increased significantly. According to IEA estimates, OPEC production (including NGLs) increased from 36.6 Million barrels per day (Mb/d) to 38.5 Mb/d in recent months. Almost half of the increase was due to growth in Iraqi crude oil production.
